newsitem.title: INDIA: India 96/97 cotton crop seen at 15.8 mln bales.
newsitem.headline: India 96/97 cotton crop seen at 15.8 mln bales.

text.p: India's 1996/97 (October/September) cotton output is likely to total 15.8 million 170-kg bales compared with 16 million the previous year, M.P. Gajaria, secretary-general of the Indian Cotton Mills Federation, told Reuters on Tuesday.
"My own feeling is that the cotton crop would be around 15.8 million bales. There is a fall in the quality and yield in the northern states of Punjab, Haryana and Rajasthan.
"In Andhra Pradesh, 200,000 bales were lost due to a cyclone."

A cyclone in October 1996 was estimated to have damaged 1.3 million hectares of crops in Andhra Pradesh state. Authorities said at the time that an estimated 55,000 hectares of cotton crops were fully or partially damaged.
